method: Post-test diagnostic queue only; does not mutate the frozen course or adjust reported score. Full source rank rows retained; homographs are not merged by minimum rank for sense decisions.
main_metric_limits: Automated exact-table matching undercounts taught orthographic variants/grammar and contains colloquial segmentation noise; matching can also overcount wrong senses. Not an estimate of comprehension.
candidate_policy: Cross-work recurrence plus independent frozen frequency, reading sense and curricular cost; do not add all errors or all fantasy terms.
